faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about Suscriptio
faq.q1: Is it free? What does Premium include?
faq.a1: Yes, you can use Suscriptio for free with up to 3 active subscriptions. Premium unlocks unlimited subscriptions, payment calendar, advanced analytics, CSV export, reminders, tags, multi-currency, spending trends, and monthly budget. All for a one-time payment of €2.99.
faq.q2: How do I stop tracking a subscription?
faq.a2: Swipe the subscription to the left or tap on it and press 'Cancel subscription'. It won't be deleted: it moves to canceled status and stops counting in your totals, but you can reactivate it anytime.
faq.a3: Absolutely. Your data is stored locally on your device. If you create an account, it syncs securely with Supabase. We never share your data with third parties.
faq.a4: Yes. Suscriptio is a PWA that works completely offline. Changes sync automatically when you regain connectivity.
faq.q5: What if I already paid and switch phones?
faq.a5: Your Premium purchase is linked to your Google Play account. Install the app on your new device, sign in with the same account, and tap 'Restore purchase' in settings.
faq.q6: Why a one-time payment instead of a subscription?
faq.a6: Because it would be ironic if a subscription management app charged you yet another subscription. Premium is a one-time €2.99 payment with permanent access and all future updates.
